name: Internship Platform — iOS 26 × Zemingo
summary: An internal multi-user platform for managing Zemingo's design internship program, taken from product definition and a functional Tailwind prototype through an iOS 26-inspired visual redesign and a final Zemingo-branded interface.
problem: Three interns needed a shared operational system for program milestones, task progress, hour logging, mentor feedback and team-leader oversight. The product also needed clear role-based access and privacy rules for mentor-authored evaluation content.
portfolio_angle: A strong example of AI-native product delivery: define the product and architecture conversationally, generate implementation-ready specifications for autonomous agents, ship a functional system first, then deliberately redesign the interface through a clear visual-language transformation.
responsibilities: Owned product concept, requirements and scope.
Defined roles, permissions, feedback privacy and core information architecture.
Designed the internship program structure and mentor feedback framework.
Directed AI-assisted implementation through repo-grounded specifications and autonomous coding workflows.
Iterated the product across multiple versions based on product and UX decisions.
Led the visual transformation from a functional Tailwind UI to an iOS 26-inspired design language and then to a Zemingo-branded system.

process.title: Product definition
process.description: Defined the internship workflow, three-tier role model, milestones, task tracking, hours logging and mentor feedback requirements.

process.title: Architecture and functional build
process.description: Specified a Next.js / TypeScript / Supabase architecture with PostgreSQL row-level security, Google Workspace authentication and Vercel deployment. The working method prioritized functional behavior before visual polish.

process.title: AI-native implementation workflow
process.description: Used Claude and autonomous-agent execution to turn product decisions into repo-anchored build instructions with exact implementation details, migrations and acceptance criteria.

process.title: UX iteration
process.description: Simplified and refined the product through successive versions: reorganized the intern experience into Tasks and Feedback, evolved the rating model, removed unnecessary functionality and preserved data through migrations.

process.title: iOS 26 design-language pass
process.description: Transformed the plain functional prototype using an iOS 26-inspired system: grouped surfaces, pill geometry, segmented controls, soft glass-like shadows, system typography and iOS-derived design tokens.

process.title: Zemingo brand layer
process.description: Applied a final brand layer over the iOS-inspired structure, introducing Zemingo typography, brand accents, selection states, progress styling and wordmark treatment.

process.title: Making-of narrative
process.description: Created a dedicated visual narrative that explicitly presents the transformation as Code → First Interface → iOS 26 → Zemingo → Final Product.

skills_demonstrated: Full-stack product implementation with AI assistance
outcomes: A working multi-user internship-management platform was built and deployed according to the project record, though production usage still requires independent verification.
The platform supports intern, mentor and team-leader workflows with database-level privacy controls.
A bilingual feedback and evaluation framework was designed as part of the product.
The functional product was transformed into a deliberately branded visual system rather than being designed as a static portfolio mockup.

conversation_hooks.agent_response_goal: Use this project to show an end-to-end AI-native methodology: conversation and product decisions → implementation-ready spec → autonomous execution → critique and iteration → design-system transformation.

conversation_hooks.recruiter_intent: Can Boaz work beyond traditional product design?

conversation_hooks.recruiter_intent: Show me a product-design case study.

conversation_hooks.agent_response_goal: Present the project as evidence that AI is integrated into the delivery loop rather than used only for ideation or asset generation.

presentation.short_pitch: An AI-native internal product I took from requirements and architecture to a working multi-user platform, then redesigned from a functional Tailwind prototype into an iOS 26-inspired, Zemingo-branded experience.
presentation.agent_opening: A good example is the internship platform I built at Zemingo. It started as an operational problem, not a design exercise: we needed one system for interns, mentors and team leaders. I used an AI-native workflow to define the product, direct the implementation and iterate it, then deliberately took the interface from functional Tailwind to an iOS 26-inspired design language and finally into Zemingo's brand.
